# 添加 destyler 版本选择器组件 (2025-12-05 18:45Z)

_**User (2025-12-05 18:48Z)**_

现在我们需要在 `ThemeSelect` 的前面加上一个 destyler 的选择器,可以选择 destyler 的版本 样式可以跟 ThemeSelect 差不多,选择版本的时候可以用 `https://npm.destyler.org/`

接下来我给你文档, 我们的版本可以用 对应框架的版本 @destyler/vue,或者 @destyler/react 这种的

```
# fast-npm-meta

[![npm version][npm-version-src]][npm-version-href]
[![npm downloads][npm-downloads-src]][npm-downloads-href]
[![bundle][bundle-src]][bundle-href]
[![JSDocs][jsdocs-src]][jsdocs-href]
[![License][license-src]][license-href]

A lightweight API server to get npm package metadata, resolve the latest versions on server, and batch multiple package resolutions in one request.

## Motivation

NPM registry's API is fairly old and not very efficient. For example, requesting https://registry.npmjs.org/vite will make you download `4.38 MB` of data, which represents `36.32 MB` of uncompressed JSON data. This is a lot of data to download just to get the latest version of a single package.

<img width="280" alt="Screenshot of fetching npm registry" src="https://github.com/antfu/antfu/assets/11247099/32a0f8c3-1be9-440f-9cea-2cbfad4a0b47">

Also, if you try to fetch that metadata from the official [`pacote`](https://github.com/npm/pacote) library, you will end up pulling [118 dependencies](https://npmgraph.js.org/?q=pacote), which sums up to [`8.48 MB` of files](https://packagephobia.com/result?p=pacote) saved on your disk.

This project aims to provide a lightweight API server as the proxy, which caches the metadata from the NPM registry and provides a more efficient way to resolve the versions of the packages.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> This project is still in the early stage of development. Pin your dependencies on usage, and feedback are greatly welcomed.

## API Endpoints

An example server is deployed at https://npm.antfu.dev/. You can also deploy your own instance.

### `GET /:pkg`

#### 📦 Get the Latest Version

```sh
curl https://npm.antfu.dev/vite
```

Returns

```json
{
  "name": "vite",
  "specifier": "latest",
  "version": "6.0.6",
  "publishedAt": "2024-12-26T02:23:38.440Z",
  "lastSynced": 1735331047889
}
```

#### 📦 Get the Latest Version of a Tag

```sh
curl https://npm.antfu.dev/vite@alpha
```

Returns

```json
{
  "name": "vite",
  "specifier": "alpha",
  "version": "6.0.0-alpha.24",
  "publishedAt": "2024-09-04T09:15:20.820Z",
  "lastSynced": 1735331047889
}
```

#### 📦 Get the Latest Version of a Range

```sh
curl https://npm.antfu.dev/vite@^2.1.0
```

Returns

```json
{
  "name": "vite",
  "specifier": "^2.1.0",
  "version": "2.9.18",
  "publishedAt": "2024-03-24T15:06:20.353Z",
  "lastSynced": 1735496799048
}
```

#### 📦 Resolve Multiple Packages

Use `+` to separate the package specs.

```sh
curl https://npm.antfu.dev/vite@alpha+vue+nuxt@~3.11
```

Returns an array of objects:

```json
[
  {
    "name": "vite",
    "specifier": "alpha",
    "version": "6.0.0-alpha.24",
    "publishedAt": "2024-09-04T09:15:20.820Z",
    "lastSynced": 1735496799048
  },
  {
    "name": "vue",
    "specifier": "latest",
    "version": "3.5.13",
    "publishedAt": "2024-11-15T14:48:51.738Z",
    "lastSynced": 1735496870654
  },
  {
    "name": "nuxt",
    "specifier": "~3.11",
    "version": "3.11.2",
    "publishedAt": "2024-04-04T16:10:14.223Z",
    "lastSynced": 1735496870614
  }
]
```

#### 📦 Get Extra Metadata

You can pass `?metadata=true` to get additional metadata about the package, such as `engines`, `deprecated`, etc.

```sh
curl https://npm.antfu.dev/versions/vite@^2.1.0?metadata=true
```

```json
{
  "name": "vite",
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=12.2.0"
  },
  "specifier": "^2.1.0",
  "version": "2.9.18",
  "publishedAt": "2024-03-24T15:06:20.353Z",
  "lastSynced": 1735496799048
}
```

### `GET /versions/:pkg`

#### 📦 Get All Versions and Tags of a Package

```sh
curl https://npm.antfu.dev/versions/vite
```

```jsonc
{
  "name": "vite",
  "distTags": {
    "previous": "5.2.5",
    "alpha": "6.0.0-alpha.18",
    "beta": "5.3.0-beta.2",
    "latest": "5.3.2"
  },
  "versions": [
    "0.1.0",
    "0.1.1",
    "0.1.2"
    // ...
  ],
  "lastSynced": 1719801079260
}
```

#### 📦 Get All Versions Published After a Certain Date

You can pass the `after` query parameter (ISO 8601 date string or timestamp) to only return versions published after a specific point in time.

```sh
curl "https://npm.antfu.dev/versions/vite?after=2025-01-01T00:00:00Z"
```

```jsonc
{
  "name": "vite",
  "specifier": "*",
  "distTags": {
    "alpha": "6.0.0-alpha.24",
    "latest": "6.3.0",
    "previous": "4.5.13",
    "beta": "6.3.0-beta.2"
  },
  "lastSynced": 1744845678674,
  "versions": [
    "6.0.7"
    // ...
  ],
  "time": {
    "6.0.7": "2025-01-02T19:50:46.030Z"
    // ...
  }
}
```

#### 📦 Get Versions satisfies the Version Range

```sh
curl https://npm.antfu.dev/versions/vite@5
```

```jsonc
{
  "name": "vite",
  "distTags": {
    "previous": "5.2.5",
    "alpha": "6.0.0-alpha.18",
    "beta": "5.3.0-beta.2",
    "latest": "5.3.2"
  },
  "versions": [
    "5.0.0",
    "5.0.1",
    "5.0.2"
    // ...
  ],
  "lastSynced": 1719801079260
}
```

#### 📦 Get All Versions and Tags of Multiple Packages

Use `+` to separate the package names.

```sh
curl https://npm.antfu.dev/versions/vite+vue+nuxt
```

This will responses with an array

### 📦 Get Versions with Metadata

Add `?metadata=true` to the URL to get additional metadata about each version, such as `engines`, `deprecated`, etc.

This would also alter the response format. `versions` and `time` will be omitted, and instead a `versionsMeta` object will be returned.

```sh
curl https://npm.antfu.dev/versions/vite?metadata=true
```

```jsonc
{
  "name": "vite",
  "distTags": {
    "previous": "5.2.5",
    "alpha": "6.0.0-alpha.18",
    "beta": "5.3.0-beta.2",
    "latest": "5.3.2"
  },
  "versionsMeta": {
    "5.0.0": {
      "version": "5.0.0",
      "engines": {
        "node": ">=12.0.0"
      },
      "deprecated": "This version is deprecated"
    },
    "5.0.1": {
      "version": "5.0.1",
      "engines": {
        "node": ">=12.0.0"
      }
    }
    // ...
  },
  "lastSynced": 1719801079260
}
```

## Error Handling

By default, the endpoint will return `400` or `500` status codes for errors.

If you want to handle the errors in the payload, or retriving partial query result, set `?throw=false` in the query string.

```sh
curl https://npm.antfu.dev/vite+non-exist?throw=false
```

It will return `200` with:

```json
[
  {
    "name": "vite",
    "specifier": "latest",
    "version": "6.2.3",
    "publishedAt": "2025-03-24T09:51:35.322Z",
    "lastSynced": 1743129342678
  },
  {
    "name": "non-exist",
    "error": "[GET] \"https://registry.npmjs.org/non-exist\": 404 Not Found"
  }
]
```

In the JavaScript API, you can pass `throw: false` in the option.

## JavaScript API

You can also use the JavaScript API to resolve the versions.

```bash
npm install fast-npm-meta
```

```ts
import { getLatestVersion } from 'fast-npm-meta'

const metadata = await getLatestVersion('vite')

console.log(metadata.version) // 5.3.2
```

## Configuration

The tool does not require any preliminary configuration to work, but you can override some default parameters through [environment variables or .env files](https://nitro.unjs.io/guide/configuration). The main ones:

| Option                | Description                      | Default                                |
|-----------------------|----------------------------------|----------------------------------------|
| `PORT`                | Port to listen on                | `3000`                                 |
| `HOST`                | Host to serve                    |                                        |
| `REPO_URL`            | Code repository URL              | https://github.com/antfu/fast-npm-meta |
| `CACHE_TIMEOUT`       | Cache timeout in ms              | `900000` (15m)                         |
| `CACHE_TIMEOUT_FORCE` | Cache timeout for forced updates | `30000` (30s)                          |
| `REGISTRY_URL`        | NPM registry URL                 | https://registry.npmjs.org             |
| `REGISTRY_USER_AGENT` | User agent for NPM registry requests | `get-npm-meta`                         |

For more information, follow [the official Nitro guides](https://nitro.unjs.io/deploy/runtimes/node#environment-variables).

我已经完成了 Destyler 版本选择器的创建。以下是我所做的更改：

## 1. 创建了新组件 `VersionSelect.vue`

新组件位于 `VersionSelect.vue`，主要功能包括：

- **从 npm.destyler.org 获取版本列表**：根据当前选择的框架（vue/react/solid/svelte）获取对应的 destyler 包版本
- **版本显示**：显示 dist tags（latest、alpha、beta 等）以及最近的稳定版本
- **响应框架切换**：当用户切换框架时，自动更新版本列表
- **事件派发**：选择版本时会派发 `destyler:version-change` 事件，包含版本号、框架和包名信息

## 2. 更新了 `Playground.astro`

- 导入了 `VersionSelect` 组件
- 将其放置在 `ThemeSelect` 前面

版本选择器的样式与 `ThemeSelect` 保持一致，宽度设为 `w-40`（比框架选择器稍宽以容纳版本号），并添加了：
- 加载状态显示（Loading...）
- 错误状态处理
- 下拉菜单滚动支持（`max-h-60 overflow-y-auto`）
- 文本截断（`truncate`）以处理较长的版本标签

如果需要在其他地方使用选中的版本信息（比如更新 import map），可以监听 `destyler:version-change` 事件来获取用户选择的版本。

  "textEditContent": "---\n/**\n * Version Select Component\n *\n * A dropdown select component for choosing the destyler package version.\n * Fetches available versions from npm.destyler.org API.\n *\n * Events:\n * - Dispatches 'destyler:version-change' when user selects a different version\n */\n---\n\n&lt;div class=\"relative mr-2\" id=\"version-select-container\"&gt;\n  &lt;button\n    id=\"version-trigger\"\n    class=\"cursor-pointer relative inline-flex place-items-center px-2 py-1 border border-solid border-border rounded-md transition-all duration-200 hover:border-accent-foreground/50 bg-transparent\"\n  &gt;\n    &lt;span id=\"version-label\" class=\"text-primary text-xs font-medium\"&gt;Loading...&lt;/span&gt;\n    &lt;span id=\"version-caret\" class=\"i-ph-caret-down-bold w-3 h-3 ml-1 transition-transform duration-200\" /&gt;\n  &lt;/button&gt;\n\n  &lt;ul\n    id=\"version-dropdown\"\n    class=\"hidden absolute left-0 top-full mt-1 bg-popover border border-solid border-border rounded-md list-none p-1 min-w-28 z-99999 shadow-lg max-h-64 overflow-y-auto\"\n  &gt;\n    &lt;!-- Versions will be dynamically inserted here --&gt;\n  &lt;/ul&gt;\n&lt;/div&gt;\n\n&lt;script&gt;\nimport { state } from '../../libs/state'\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Constants\n// ============================================================================\n\nconst EVENTS = {\n  VERSION_CHANGE: 'destyler:version-change',\n  FRAMEWORK_CHANGE: 'framework:change',\n} as const\n\nconst FRAMEWORK_PACKAGE_MAP: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {\n  vue: '@destyler/vue',\n  react: '@destyler/react',\n  solid: '@destyler/solid',\n  svelte: '@destyler/svelte',\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// State\n// ============================================================================\n\nlet expanded = false\nlet versions: string[] = []\nlet selectedVersion = 'latest'\nlet currentPackage = ''\n\n// ============================================================================\n// DOM Elements\n// ============================================================================\n\nfunction getElements() {\n  return {\n    container: document.getElementById('version-select-container'),\n    trigger: document.getElementById('version-trigger'),\n    label: document.getElementById('version-label'),\n    caret: document.getElementById('version-caret'),\n    dropdown: document.getElementById('version-dropdown'),\n  }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Methods\n// ============================================================================\n\nasync function fetchVersions(packageName: string): Promise&lt;string[]&gt; {\n  try {\n    const response = await fetch(&#96;https://npm.destyler.org/versions/${packageName}&#96;)\n    if (!response.ok) {\n      throw new Error(&#96;Failed to fetch versions: ${response.status}&#96;)\n    }\n    const data = await response.json()\n    return data.versions || []\n  }\n  catch (error) {\n    console.error('Failed to fetch versions:', error)\n    return []\n  }\n}\n\nfunction updateUI() {\n  const { label, caret, dropdown } = getElements()\n\n  if (label) {\n    label.textContent = selectedVersion\n  }\n\n  if (caret) {\n    if (expanded) {\n      caret.classList.add('rotate-180')\n    }\n    else {\n      caret.classList.remove('rotate-180')\n    }\n  }\n\n  if (dropdown) {\n    if (expanded) {\n      dropdown.classList.remove('hidden')\n      dropdown.classList.add('block')\n    }\n    else {\n      dropdown.classList.remove('block')\n      dropdown.classList.add('hidden')\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nfunction renderVersionList() {\n  const { dropdown } = getElements()\n  if (!dropdown)\n    return\n\n  dropdown.innerHTML = versions\n    .slice(0, 30) // Limit to 30 versions\n    .map((version) =&gt; {\n      const isActive = version === selectedVersion\n      return &#96;\n        &lt;li class=\"rounded\"&gt;\n          &lt;a\n            data-version=\"${version}\"\n            class=\"block px-2.5 py-1.5 no-underline cursor-pointer text-popover-foreground text-xs rounded transition-colors duration-150 hover:bg-accent ${isActive ? 'text-primary font-medium' : ''}\"\n          &gt;\n            ${version}\n          &lt;/a&gt;\n        &lt;/li&gt;\n      &#96;\n    })\n    .join('')\n\n  // Attach click handlers to version items\n  dropdown.querySelectorAll('a[data-version]').forEach((item) =&gt; {\n    item.addEventListener('click', (e) =&gt; {\n      e.stopPropagation()\n      const version = (item as HTMLElement).dataset.version\n      if (version) {\n        setVersion(version)\n      }\n    })\n  })\n}\n\nfunction setVersion(version: string) {\n  if (selectedVersion === version) {\n    expanded = false\n    updateUI()\n    return\n  }\n\n  selectedVersion = version\n  expanded = false\n  updateUI()\n  renderVersionList()\n\n  window.dispatchEvent(\n    new CustomEvent(EVENTS.VERSION_CHANGE, {\n      detail: { version, package: currentPackage },\n    }),\n  )\n}\n\nfunction toggle() {\n  expanded = !expanded\n  updateUI()\n}\n\nfunction handleClickOutside(e: MouseEvent) {\n  const { container } = getElements()\n  if (container &amp;&amp; !container.contains(e.target as Node)) {\n    expanded = false\n    updateUI()\n  }\n}\n\nfunction handleBlur() {\n  if (document.activeElement?.tagName === 'IFRAME') {\n    expanded = false\n    updateUI()\n  }\n}\n\nasync function loadVersionsForFramework(framework: string) {\n  const packageName = FRAMEWORK_PACKAGE_MAP[framework]\n  if (!packageName || packageName === currentPackage) {\n    return\n  }\n\n  currentPackage = packageName\n  const { label } = getElements()\n\n  if (label) {\n    label.textContent = 'Loading...'\n  }\n\n  versions = await fetchVersions(packageName)\n\n  if (versions.length &gt; 0) {\n    selectedVersion = versions[0]\n  }\n  else {\n    selectedVersion = 'latest'\n  }\n\n  updateUI()\n  renderVersionList()\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\nfunction initVersionSelect() {\n  const { trigger, container } = getElements()\n\n  if (!trigger || !container)\n    return\n\n  // Avoid duplicate listeners\n  if ((container as any).__initialized) {\n    return\n  }\n  (container as any).__initialized = true\n\n  // Toggle dropdown\n  trigger.addEventListener('click', (e) =&gt; {\n    e.stopPropagation()\n    toggle()\n  })\n\n  // Close on click outside\n  window.addEventListener('click', handleClickOutside)\n  window.addEventListener('blur', handleBlur)\n\n  // Listen for framework changes\n  window.addEventListener(EVENTS.FRAMEWORK_CHANGE, ((e: CustomEvent&lt;{ framework: string }&gt;) =&gt; {\n    loadVersionsForFramework(e.detail.framework)\n  }) as EventListener)\n\n  // Load initial versions\n  loadVersionsForFramework(state.activeFramework)\n}\n\ndocument.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initVersionSelect)\ndocument.addEventListener('astro:page-load', initVersionSelect)\n&lt;/script&gt;\n",

   - `max-h-64 overflow-y-auto` - 滚动支持
   - `hover:bg-accent` - 悬停高亮

3. **保持相同功能**

  "content": "&#96;&#96;&#96;astro\n---\n/**\n * Version Select Component\n *\n * A dropdown select component for choosing the destyler package version.\n * Fetches available versions from npm.destyler.org API.\n * Based on Vue SFC Playground's VersionSelect component style.\n *\n * Events:\n * - Dispatches 'destyler:version-change' when user selects a different version\n */\n---\n\n&lt;div class=\"version\" id=\"version-select-container\"&gt;\n  &lt;span class=\"active-version\" id=\"version-trigger\"&gt;\n    &lt;span id=\"version-pkg-label\"&gt;Destyler&lt;/span&gt;\n    &lt;span class=\"number\" id=\"version-label\"&gt;latest&lt;/span&gt;\n  &lt;/span&gt;\n\n  &lt;ul class=\"versions\" id=\"version-dropdown\"&gt;\n    &lt;li id=\"version-loading\"&gt;&lt;a&gt;loading versions...&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/li&gt;\n  &lt;/ul&gt;\n&lt;/div&gt;\n\n&lt;style&gt;\n.version {\n  margin-right: 12px;\n  position: relative;\n}\n\n.active-version {\n  cursor: pointer;\n  position: relative;\n  display: inline-flex;\n  place-items: center;\n  font-size: 13px;\n  color: var(--primary);\n}\n\n.active-version .number {\n  color: var(--accent-foreground);\n  margin-left: 4px;\n}\n\n.active-version::after {\n  content: '';\n  width: 0;\n  height: 0;\n  border-left: 4px solid transparent;\n  border-right: 4px solid transparent;\n  border-top: 6px solid var(--muted-foreground);\n  margin-left: 8px;\n}\n\n.versions {\n  display: none;\n  position: absolute;\n  left: 0;\n  top: 30px;\n  background-color: var(--popover);\n  border: 1px solid var(--border);\n  border-radius: 4px;\n  list-style-type: none;\n  padding: 8px;\n  margin: 0;\n  width: 200px;\n  max-height: 300px;\n  overflow: scroll;\n  z-index: 99999;\n}\n\n.versions.expanded {\n  display: block;\n}\n\n.versions a {\n  display: block;\n  padding: 6px 12px;\n  text-decoration: none;\n  cursor: pointer;\n  color: var(--popover-foreground);\n  font-size: 13px;\n  border-radius: 4px;\n}\n\n.versions a:hover {\n  background-color: var(--accent);\n}\n\n.versions .active a {\n  color: var(--accent-foreground);\n}\n\n.versions li {\n  display: flex;\n  justify-content: space-between;\n  align-items: center;\n}\n&lt;/style&gt;\n\n&lt;script&gt;\nimport { state } from '../../libs/state'\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Constants\n// ============================================================================\n\nconst EVENTS = {\n  VERSION_CHANGE: 'destyler:version-change',\n  FRAMEWORK_CHANGE: 'framework:change',\n} as const\n\nconst FRAMEWORK_PACKAGE_MAP: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {\n  vue: '@destyler/vue',\n  react: '@destyler/react',\n  solid: '@destyler/solid',\n  svelte: '@destyler/svelte',\n}\n\nconst FRAMEWORK_LABEL_MAP: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {\n  vue: 'Destyler Vue',\n  react: 'Destyler React',\n  solid: 'Destyler Solid',\n  svelte: 'Destyler Svelte',\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// State\n// ============================================================================\n\nlet expanded = false\nlet versions: string[] | null = null\nlet selectedVersion = 'latest'\nlet currentPackage = ''\nlet currentFramework = ''\n\n// ============================================================================\n// DOM Elements\n// ============================================================================\n\nfunction getElements() {\n  return {\n    container: document.getElementById('version-select-container'),\n    trigger: document.getElementById('version-trigger'),\n    pkgLabel: document.getElementById('version-pkg-label'),\n    label: document.getElementById('version-label'),\n    dropdown: document.getElementById('version-dropdown'),\n    loading: document.getElementById('version-loading'),\n  }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Methods\n// ============================================================================\n\nasync function fetchVersions(packageName: string): Promise&lt;string[]&gt; {\n  try {\n    const response = await fetch(&#96;https://npm.destyler.org/versions/${packageName}&#96;)\n    if (!response.ok) {\n      throw new Error(&#96;Failed to fetch versions: ${response.status}&#96;)\n    }\n    const data = await response.json()\n    return data.versions || []\n  }\n  catch (error) {\n    console.error('Failed to fetch versions:', error)\n    return []\n  }\n}\n\nfunction updateUI() {\n  const { label, dropdown, pkgLabel } = getElements()\n\n  if (label) {\n    label.textContent = selectedVersion\n  }\n\n  if (pkgLabel &amp;&amp; currentFramework) {\n    pkgLabel.textContent = FRAMEWORK_LABEL_MAP[currentFramework] || 'Destyler'\n  }\n\n  if (dropdown) {\n    if (expanded) {\n      dropdown.classList.add('expanded')\n    }\n    else {\n      dropdown.classList.remove('expanded')\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nfunction renderVersionList() {\n  const { dropdown, loading } = getElements()\n  if (!dropdown)\n    return\n\n  // Hide loading\n  if (loading) {\n    loading.style.display = 'none'\n  }\n\n  // Remove existing version items (except loading)\n  const existingItems = dropdown.querySelectorAll('li:not(#version-loading)')\n  existingItems.forEach((item) =&gt; item.remove())\n\n  if (!versions || versions.length === 0) {\n    return\n  }\n\n  // Add version items\n  versions.slice(0, 30).forEach((version, index) =&gt; {\n    const isActive = version === selectedVersion || (selectedVersion === 'latest' &amp;&amp; index === 0)\n    const li = document.createElement('li')\n    li.className = isActive ? 'active' : ''\n\n    const a = document.createElement('a')\n    a.textContent = &#96;v${version}&#96;\n    a.addEventListener('click', (e) =&gt; {\n      e.stopPropagation()\n      setVersion(version)\n    })\n\n    li.appendChild(a)\n    dropdown.appendChild(li)\n  })\n}\n\nfunction setVersion(version: string) {\n  selectedVersion = version\n  expanded = false\n  updateUI()\n  renderVersionList()\n\n  window.dispatchEvent(\n    new CustomEvent(EVENTS.VERSION_CHANGE, {\n      detail: { version, package: currentPackage },\n    }),\n  )\n}\n\nasync function toggle() {\n  expanded = !expanded\n  updateUI()\n\n  if (expanded &amp;&amp; !versions) {\n    const { loading } = getElements()\n    if (loading) {\n      loading.style.display = 'block'\n    }\n    versions = await fetchVersions(currentPackage)\n    if (versions.length &gt; 0) {\n      selectedVersion = versions[0]\n    }\n    updateUI()\n    renderVersionList()\n  }\n}\n\nfunction handleClickOutside() {\n  expanded = false\n  updateUI()\n}\n\nfunction handleBlur() {\n  if (document.activeElement?.tagName === 'IFRAME') {\n    expanded = false\n    updateUI()\n  }\n}\n\nasync function loadVersionsForFramework(framework: string) {\n  const packageName = FRAMEWORK_PACKAGE_MAP[framework]\n  if (!packageName) {\n    return\n  }\n\n  // Reset state for new framework\n  currentPackage = packageName\n  currentFramework = framework\n  versions = null\n  selectedVersion = 'latest'\n  expanded = false\n\n  updateUI()\n\n  // Clear existing version list\n  const { dropdown, loading } = getElements()\n  if (dropdown) {\n    const existingItems = dropdown.querySelectorAll('li:not(#version-loading)')\n    existingItems.forEach((item) =&gt;   "textEditContent": "---\n/**\n * Version Select Component\n *\n * A dropdown select component for choosing the destyler package version.\n * Fetches available versions from npm.destyler.org API.\n * Based on Vue SFC Playground's VersionSelect component style.\n *\n * Events:\n * - Dispatches 'destyler:version-change' when user selects a different version\n */\n---\n\n&lt;div class=\"version\" id=\"version-select-container\"&gt;\n  &lt;span class=\"active-version\" id=\"version-trigger\"&gt;\n    &lt;span id=\"version-pkg-label\"&gt;Destyler&lt;/span&gt;\n    &lt;span class=\"number\" id=\"version-label\"&gt;latest&lt;/span&gt;\n  &lt;/span&gt;\n\n  &lt;ul class=\"versions\" id=\"version-dropdown\"&gt;\n    &lt;li id=\"version-loading\"&gt;&lt;a&gt;loading versions...&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/li&gt;\n  &lt;/ul&gt;\n&lt;/div&gt;\n\n&lt;style&gt;\n.version {\n  margin-right: 12px;\n  position: relative;\n}\n\n.active-version {\n  cursor: pointer;\n  position: relative;\n  display: inline-flex;\n  place-items: center;\n  font-size: 13px;\n  color: var(--primary);\n}\n\n.active-version .number {\n  color: var(--accent-foreground);\n  margin-left: 4px;\n}\n\n.active-version::after {\n  content: '';\n  width: 0;\n  height: 0;\n  border-left: 4px solid transparent;\n  border-right: 4px solid transparent;\n  border-top: 6px solid var(--muted-foreground);\n  margin-left: 8px;\n}\n\n.versions {\n  display: none;\n  position: absolute;\n  left: 0;\n  top: 30px;\n  background-color: var(--popover);\n  border: 1px solid var(--border);\n  border-radius: 4px;\n  list-style-type: none;\n  padding: 8px;\n  margin: 0;\n  width: 200px;\n  max-height: 300px;\n  overflow: scroll;\n  z-index: 99999;\n}\n\n.versions.expanded {\n  display: block;\n}\n\n.versions a {\n  display: block;\n  padding: 6px 12px;\n  text-decoration: none;\n  cursor: pointer;\n  color: var(--popover-foreground);\n  font-size: 13px;\n  border-radius: 4px;\n}\n\n.versions a:hover {\n  background-color: var(--accent);\n}\n\n.versions .active a {\n  color: var(--accent-foreground);\n}\n\n.versions li {\n  display: flex;\n  justify-content: space-between;\n  align-items: center;\n}\n&lt;/style&gt;\n\n&lt;script&gt;\nimport { state } from '../../libs/state'\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Constants\n// ============================================================================\n\nconst EVENTS = {\n  VERSION_CHANGE: 'destyler:version-change',\n  FRAMEWORK_CHANGE: 'framework:change',\n} as const\n\nconst FRAMEWORK_PACKAGE_MAP: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {\n  vue: '@destyler/vue',\n  react: '@destyler/react',\n  solid: '@destyler/solid',\n  svelte: '@destyler/svelte',\n}\n\nconst FRAMEWORK_LABEL_MAP: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {\n  vue: 'Destyler Vue',\n  react: 'Destyler React',\n  solid: 'Destyler Solid',\n  svelte: 'Destyler Svelte',\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// State\n// ============================================================================\n\nlet expanded = false\nlet versions: string[] | null = null\nlet selectedVersion = 'latest'\nlet currentPackage = ''\nlet currentFramework = ''\n\n// ============================================================================\n// DOM Elements\n// ============================================================================\n\nfunction getElements() {\n  return {\n    container: document.getElementById('version-select-container'),\n    trigger: document.getElementById('version-trigger'),\n    pkgLabel: document.getElementById('version-pkg-label'),\n    label: document.getElementById('version-label'),\n    dropdown: document.getElementById('version-dropdown'),\n    loading: document.getElementById('version-loading'),\n  }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Methods\n// ============================================================================\n\nasync function fetchVersions(packageName: string): Promise&lt;string[]&gt; {\n  try {\n    const response = await fetch(&#96;https://npm.destyler.org/versions/${packageName}&#96;)\n    if (!response.ok) {\n      throw new Error(&#96;Failed to fetch versions: ${response.status}&#96;)\n    }\n    const data = await response.json()\n    return data.versions || []\n  }\n  catch (error) {\n    console.error('Failed to fetch versions:', error)\n    return []\n  }\n}\n\nfunction updateUI() {\n  const { label, dropdown, pkgLabel } = getElements()\n\n  if (label) {\n    label.textContent = selectedVersion\n  }\n\n  if (pkgLabel &amp;&amp; currentFramework) {\n    pkgLabel.textContent = FRAMEWORK_LABEL_MAP[currentFramework] || 'Destyler'\n  }\n\n  if (dropdown) {\n    if (expanded) {\n      dropdown.classList.add('expanded')\n    }\n    else {\n      dropdown.classList.remove('expanded')\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nfunction renderVersionList() {\n  const { dropdown, loading } = getElements()\n  if (!dropdown)\n    return\n\n  // Hide loading\n  if (loading) {\n    loading.style.display = 'none'\n  }\n\n  // Remove existing version items (except loading)\n  const existingItems = dropdown.querySelectorAll('li:not(#version-loading)')\n  existingItems.forEach((item) =&gt; item.remove())\n\n  if (!versions || versions.length === 0) {\n    return\n  }\n\n  // Add version items\n  versions.slice(0, 30).forEach((version, index) =&gt; {\n    const isActive = version === selectedVersion || (selectedVersion === 'latest' &amp;&amp; index === 0)\n    const li = document.createElement('li')\n    li.className = isActive ? 'active' : ''\n\n    const a = document.createElement('a')\n    a.textContent = &#96;v${version}&#96;\n    a.addEventListener('click', (e) =&gt; {\n      e.stopPropagation()\n      setVersion(version)\n    })\n\n    li.appendChild(a)\n    dropdown.appendChild(li)\n  })\n}\n\nfunction setVersion(version: string) {\n  selectedVersion = version\n  expanded = false\n  updateUI()\n  renderVersionList()\n\n  window.dispatchEvent(\n    new CustomEvent(EVENTS.VERSION_CHANGE, {\n      detail: { version, package: currentPackage },\n    }),\n  )\n}\n\nasync function toggle() {\n  expanded = !expanded\n  updateUI()\n\n  if (expanded &amp;&amp; !versions) {\n    const { loading } = getElements()\n    if (loading) {\n      loading.style.display = 'block'\n    }\n    versions = await fetchVersions(currentPackage)\n    if (versions.length &gt; 0) {\n      selectedVersion = versions[0]\n    }\n    updateUI()\n    renderVersionList()\n  }\n}\n\nfunction handleClickOutside() {\n  expanded = false\n  updateUI()\n}\n\nfunction handleBlur() {\n  if (document.activeElement?.tagName === 'IFRAME') {\n    expanded = false\n    updateUI()\n  }\n}\n\nasync function loadVersionsForFramework(framework: string) {\n  const packageName = FRAMEWORK_PACKAGE_MAP[framework]\n  if (!packageName) {\n    return\n  }\n\n  // Reset state for new framework\n  currentPackage = packageName\n  currentFramework = framework\n  versions = null\n  selectedVersion = 'latest'\n  expanded = false\n\n  updateUI()\n\n  // Clear existing version list\n  const { dropdown, loading } = getElements()\n  if (dropdown) {\n    const existingItems = dropdown.querySelectorAll('li:not(#version-loading)')\n    existingItems.forEach((item) =&gt; item.remove())\n  }\n  if (loading) {\n    loading.style.display = 'block'\n  }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\nfunction initVersionSelect() {\n  const { trigger, container } = getElements()\n\n  if (!trigger || !container)\n    return\n\n  // Avoid duplicate listeners\n  if ((container as any).__initialized) {\n    return\n  }\n  (container as any).__initialized = true\n\n  // Toggle dropdown\n  trigger.addEventListener('click', (e) =&gt; {\n    e.stopPropagation()\n    toggle()\n  })\n\n  // Close on click outside\n  window.addEventListener('click', handleClickOutside)\n  window.addEventListener('blur', handleBlur)\n\n  // Listen for framework changes\n  window.addEventListener(EVENTS.FRAMEWORK_CHANGE, ((e: CustomEvent&lt;{ framework: string }&gt;) =&gt; {\n    loadVersionsForFramework(e.detail.framework)\n  }) as EventListener)\n\n  // Load initial state\n  currentFramework = state.activeFramework\n  currentPackage = FRAMEWORK_PACKAGE_MAP[state.activeFramework] || '@destyler/vue'\n  updateUI()\n}\n\ndocument.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initVersionSelect)\ndocument.addEventListener('astro:page-load', initVersionSelect)\n&lt;/script&gt;",

}

**主要变化：**

1. **模板结构** - 与 Vue REPL 一致：
   - 使用 `.version` 容器
   - `.active-version` 显示当前选择（包含标签和版本号）
   - `.versions` 下拉列表，通过 `.expanded` 类控制显示

2. **样式** - 匹配 Vue SFC Playground：
   - 使用 CSS 三角形箭头（`::after` 伪元素）
   - 版本号显示为绿色（`--accent-foreground`）
   - 下拉列表绝对定位，带边框和圆角
   - 悬停效果和选中高亮

3. **行为**：
   - 点击触发器展开/收起下拉菜单
   - 点击版本项选择版本
   - 点击外部或 iframe 获得焦点时自动关闭
   - 首次展开时才加载版本列表
   - 切换框架时重置版本列表

4. **显示格式**：
   - 显示 "Destyler Vue v1.0.0" 格式
   - 根据当前框架显示对应的包名称
